pattern_explanation: These Hebrew words resemble English words because of shared European roots, but their meanings diverged over time, so the closest English form often means something different.
false_friend_warning: Protokol looks like English 'protocol' but means the minutes of a meeting; 'sensatsia' means a sensational news story rather than a sensation; 'aktuali' means topical rather than actual; and 'nusach' means wording or version of a text.
